description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with methods to generate URL-friendly slugs from strings by removing invalid characters, normalizing spaces, limiting length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static helper class for generating URL slugs from strings, includes regex patterns compiled with [GeneratedRegex] attribute.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL slug by cleaning invalid characters, normalizing spaces, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.
